using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.Bundling;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling.Scripts;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling.Styles;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling.Tests;

public class BundlingServiceTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<BundlingService>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly Mock<IDotNetProjectBuilder> _mockDotNetProjectBuilder;
    private readonly Mock<IJavascriptMinifier> _mockJsMinifier;
    private readonly Mock<ICssMinifier> _mockCssMinifier;
    private readonly Mock<IScriptBundler> _mockScriptBundler;
    private readonly Mock<IStyleBundler> _mockStyleBundler;
    private readonly Mock<IConfigReader> _mockConfigReader;
    private readonly Mock<CliVersionService> _mockCliVersionService;

    public BundlingServiceTests()
    {
        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<BundlingService>>();
        _mockDotNetProjectBuilder = new Mock<IDotNetProjectBuilder>();
        _mockJsMinifier = new Mock<IJavascriptMinifier>();
        _mockCssMinifier = new Mock<ICssMinifier>();
        _mockScriptBundler = new Mock<IScriptBundler>();
        _mockStyleBundler = new Mock<IStyleBundler>();
        _mockConfigReader = new Mock<IConfigReader>();
        _mockCliVersionService = new Mock<CliVersionService>();
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task BundleAsync_ReferencesMode_ShouldLogGeneratingScriptReferences()
    {
        // Arrange
        var directory = "/test/dir";
        var projectFilePath = Path.Combine(directory, "TestProject.csproj");
        var bundleDefinitions = new List<BundleTypeDefinition>();
        var bundleConfig = new BundleConfig
        {
            Mode = BundlingMode.References, // Triggers the else branch
            InteractiveAuto = true // Skip file update section
        };

        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        File.WriteAllText(projectFilePath, "<Project></Project>");

        _mockConfigReader.Setup(r => r.Read(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(bundleConfig);
        _mockStyleBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>())).Returns("style-output");
        _mockScriptBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>())).Returns("script-output");

        var service = CreateBundlingService();

        // Act
        await service.BundleAsync(directory, false);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Generating script references...")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task BundleAsync_BundleMode_ShouldNotLogGeneratingScriptReferences()
    {
        // Arrange
        var directory = "/test/dir2";
        var projectFilePath = Path.Combine(directory, "TestProject2.csproj");
        var bundleConfig = new BundleConfig
        {
            Mode = BundlingMode.Bundle, // Triggers the if branch
            InteractiveAuto = true
        };

        Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
        File.WriteAllText(projectFilePath, "<Project></Project>");

        _mockConfigReader.Setup(r => r.Read(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(bundleConfig);
        _mockStyleBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>())).Returns("style-output");
        _mockScriptBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>())).Returns("script-output");

        var service = CreateBundlingService();

        // Act
        await service.BundleAsync(directory, false);

        // Assert - Should log "Generating script bundle..." instead
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Generating script references...")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    private BundlingService CreateBundlingService()
    {
        var service = new BundlingService
        {
            DotNetProjectBuilder = _mockDotNetProjectBuilder.Object,
            JsMinifier = _mockJsMinifier.Object,
            CssMinifier = _mockCssMinifier.Object,
            Logger = _mockLogger.Object,
            ScriptBundler = _mockScriptBundler.Object,
            StyleBundler = _mockStyleBundler.Object,
            ConfigReader = _mockConfigReader.Object,
            CliVersionService = _mockCliVersionService.Object
        };

        return service;
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.Bundling;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling.Tests;

public class BundlingServiceTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IScriptBundler> _mockScriptBundler;
    private readonly Mock<IStyleBundler> _mockStyleBundler;
    private readonly List<BundleTypeDefinition> _bundleDefinitions;
    private readonly BundleConfig _bundleConfig;

    public BundlingServiceTests()
    {
        _mockScriptBundler = new Mock<IScriptBundler>();
        _mockStyleBundler = new Mock<IStyleBundler>();
        _bundleDefinitions = new List<BundleTypeDefinition>();
        _bundleConfig = new BundleConfig { Mode = BundlingMode.References, InteractiveAuto = true };
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task BundleAsync_ReferencesMode_ShouldLogGeneratingScriptReferences()
    {
        // Arrange
        var directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        var service = CreateBundlingService(directory);
        
        MockStaticDependencies(service, directory);

        // Act
        await service.BundleAsync(directory, false);

        // Assert - Logger.LogInformation("Generating script references...") was called
        Mock.Get(service.Logger)
            .Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Generating script references..."), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task BundleAsync_BundleMode_ShouldNotLogGeneratingScriptReferences()
    {
        // Arrange
        var directory = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString());
        _bundleConfig.Mode = BundlingMode.Bundle;
        var service = CreateBundlingService(directory);
        
        MockStaticDependencies(service, directory);
        _mockStyleBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
                        .Returns("style-output");
        _mockScriptBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
                         .Returns("script-output");

        // Act
        await service.BundleAsync(directory, false);

        // Assert - Should NOT log "Generating script references..."
        Mock.Get(service.Logger)
            .Verify(l => l.LogInformation("Generating script references..."), Times.Never);
    }

    private BundlingService CreateBundlingService(string directory)
    {
        var service = new BundlingService
        {
            Logger = NullLogger<BundlingService>.Instance,
            ScriptBundler = _mockScriptBundler.Object,
            StyleBundler = _mockStyleBundler.Object
        };

        // Manually set private fields using reflection to avoid missing dependencies
        typeof(BundlingService).GetProperty("ConfigReader")?
            .SetValue(service, new Mock<IConfigReader>().Object);
        
        return service;
    }

    private void MockStaticDependencies(BundlingService service, string directory)
    {
        // Mock ConfigReader to return our bundle config
        var configReaderMock = Mock.Get((IConfigReader)service.ConfigReader!);
        configReaderMock.Setup(r => r.Read(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(_bundleConfig);

        // Setup other mocks to return safe values
        _mockStyleBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
                        .Returns("style-output");
        _mockScriptBundler.Setup(b => b.Bundle(It.IsAny<BundleOptions>(), It.IsAny<BundleContext>()))
                         .Returns("script-output");
    }
}

namespace Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling.Tests;

public class BundlingServiceTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task BundleAsync_ReferencesMode_ShouldLogGeneratingScriptReferences()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<BundlingService>>();
        var service = new BundlingService
        {
            Logger = mockLogger.Object,
            ConfigReader = Mock.Of<IConfigReader>(r => r.Read(It.IsAny<string>()) == 
                new BundleConfig { Mode = BundlingMode.References, InteractiveAuto = true }),
            ScriptBundler = Mock.Of<IScriptBundler>(),
            StyleBundler = Mock.Of<IStyleBundler>()
        };

        // Create minimal test environment to pass initial checks
        var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
        File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(tempDir, "Test.csproj"), "<Project Sdk=\"Microsoft.NET.Sdk\"><PropertyGroup /></Project>");

        try
        {
            // Act
            await service.BundleAsync(tempDir, false, "WebAssembly");

        finally
        {
            Directory.Delete(tempDir, true);
